data.name: Quaternary sand deposits, unit 1 (coastal)
data.descrip: Extensive marine and nonmarine sand deposits, generally near the coast or desert playas
data.comments: Sand deposits in coastal areas, including beach sand and eolian dunes Original map source: Saucedo, G.J., Bedford, D.R., Raines, G.L., Miller, R.J., and Wentworth, C.M., 2000, GIS Data for the Geologic Map of California, California Department of Conservation, Division of Mines and Geology, CD-ROM 2000-07, scale 1:750,000. Primary reference: Jennings, C.W., with modifications by Gutierrez, C., Bryant, W., Saucedo, G., and Wills, C., 2010, Geologic map of California, Version 2.0 (California Geological Survey 150th Anniversary Edition), Department of Conservation, California Geological Survey: California Geologic Data Map Series, GDM No. 2, scale 1:750,000.
